findings.source_passage: As most young candidates for the pains and penalties of whaling stop at this same New Bedford, thence to embark on their voyage, it may as well be related
findings.why_it_matters: The ironic framing of whaling candidates accepting 'pains and penalties' is voice-establishing; the draft drops the opening clause entirely, beginning mid-sentence without the satirical setup.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore 'As most young candidates for the pains and penalties of whaling stop at this same New Bedford, thence to embark on their voyage' before the retained clause.

findings.source_passage: and heard a forlorn creaking in the air; and looking up, saw a swinging sign over the door with a white painting upon it, faintly representing
findings.why_it_matters: The draft omits 'heard a forlorn creaking in the air' and 'over the door with a white painting upon it,' losing the atmospheric auditory detail and the explicit description of the painting that precedes the verbal sign.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore the forlorn creaking and the mention of the white painting in the sign description.

summary: The draft is largely faithful, preserving nearly all signature passages including the Ishmael soliloquy, 'The Trap' sequence, Tophet paragraph, Euroclydon digression, and Lazarus/Dives meditation verbatim; two minor voice flattenings are present but neither rises to high severity.
